In [[mathematics]], the '''compact complement topology''' is a [[topological space|topology]] defined on the set <math>\scriptstyle\mathbb{R}</math> of [[real numbers]], defined by declaring a [[subset]] <math>\scriptstyle X \subseteq \mathbb{R}</math> [[open set|open]] [[if and only if]] it is either empty or its [[complement (set theory)|complement]] <math>\scriptstyle\mathbb{R} \setminus X</math> is compact in the standard [[Euclidean space|Euclidean topology]] on <math>\scriptstyle\mathbb{R}</math>.
